universal_lens: The physiological adaptation to training intensity distributions is modeled as a non-linear operator acting on the cardiometabolic state vector. The polarized distribution maximizes the spectral radius of the metabolic efficiency matrix, optimizing the eigenvalues associated with mitochondrial biogenesis and lipid oxidation under bounded energetic constraints. Polarized training intensity distribution optimizes cardiorespiratory fitness and metabolic health via adaptive regulation of exercise volume and perceived exertion.
